title: Pad Krapao
paragraphs: Pad Krapao is a quick stir-fry of holy basil with meat or tofu, chilies, garlic, and a savory sauce, usually served over rice with a crispy fried egg.
Holy basil (krapao) brings a peppery, herbal kick distinct from Thai sweet basil. It’s a go-to comfort dish and lunchtime favorite across the country.
